shop_info.description: Information about the shop's pricing and currency.

sells_at.description: The percentage at which the shop sells items (e.g., 1000 = 100%). Absent when the wiki infobox does not state it.

buys_at.description: The percentage at which the shop buys items (e.g., 500 = 50%). Absent when the wiki infobox does not state it.

change_per.description: The percentage change per item stocked/sold. Absent when the wiki infobox does not state it.

currency.description: The currency type used in the shop.

owners.description: The NPC(s) that run the shop, from the wiki infobox owner field.

name.description: The name of the shopkeeper, as displayed on the wiki.

wiki_page.description: The OSRS Wiki page of the shopkeeper, if the owner is linked.

npc_ids.description: Unique OSRS NPC IDs of the shopkeeper, from its wiki infobox.

option.description: The click option that opens the shop, null when it opens through dialogue.

option_slot.description: The 1-based menu slot of that option, matching npcs-interactions.json.

option_source.description: How the shop is opened: 'click' (use option_slot), 'dialogue' (talk to the NPC), or 'unknown' (no click options known for this NPC ID).

items.description: Array of items sold in the shop.

stock.description: The amount of items in stock (integer or 'infinite' string).

restock_time.description: The time (in ticks) for the item to restock (integer or 'N/A' string).

currency.description: Currency for this row, present only when it differs from shop_info.currency.
